To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
APS can reverse the multidrug resistance of H22/ ADM hepatoma cells in a dose and time-dependent manner.
APS can enhance the sensitivity of H22/ ADM cells to chemotherapeutic drugs by inhibiting P-GP efflx pump function and down regulating P-GP and MDR1 protein expression.

APS can increase the cytotoxcity of certain chemotherapy in H22/ ADM cells in vitro, and it may act through the downregulation MDR1 mRNA, inhibition of P-glycoprotien efflux pump function or both, which decrease the expression of MDR1 protein.

the reversal of MDR and the mechanism of action of APS.
the reversal of MDR in cancer cells by APS.
the reversal of MDR in H22 hepatocarcinoma cells by APS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
APS can reverse the MDR phenotype of H22/ ADM cells.
APS can enhance the chemotherapeutic effect of chemotherapy drugs in H22/ ADM cells by reversing the function of the MDR efflux pump.
APS can reverse the MDR of cancer cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
APS may be a potential candidate to overcome MDR in H22/ ADM cells.
APS can enhance the sensitivity of H22/ADMC cells by inhibiting the expression of P-GP.
APS may be a useful adjunctive treatment for cancer patients who have MDR.

APS can reverse P-GP mediated drug resistance in H22/AD cells.
APS may have a role in reversing MDR.
